name: avalara-communications
title: Avalara Communications
summary: Provides access to Avalara Communications tax calculation for voice, data, VoIP, and messaging
description: Avalara Communications MCP server provides AI agents with communications tax calculation for voice, data, VoIP, messaging, and related telecom services. It supports jurisdiction coding, geocoding, address validation, and tax reporting workflows over streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1.

useCases.name: Telecom tax calculation
useCases.description: Calculate communications taxes for voice, data, VoIP, wireless, and messaging transactions so billing systems and agents apply the correct tax types.

useCases.name: Jurisdiction and geocoding support
useCases.description: Resolve jurisdiction codes and validate service addresses to determine which communications taxes apply for a given location.

useCases.name: Communications tax reporting
useCases.description: Retrieve tax calculation outputs needed for communications tax reporting and compliance reviews.
